text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, a fan letter arrives for<n>Seeking the Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, to think someone would take<n>the time to
write me a letter to<n>express their feelings. I must
wholly<n>embrace their heartfelt passion!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Excellent! Apparently, I've inspired<n>them to try
opening their own cafe!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing you continuously taking on<n>challenges
made me want to try<n>accomplishing something of
my own,<n>Pearl!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Things were pretty tough at first, but<n>business has
finally started to take<n>off. It would mean the world
to me if<n>you dropped by for a meal<n>sometime!"
Why... that sounds<n>splendid!
choice_data_list:
Your hard work gave them the courage to challenge
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, you're right. I'm so happy.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's go and pay their cafe<n>a visit!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I have arrived! Now where's that<n>meal you
mentioned?!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?! No way! P-Pearl... You<n>actually came?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What do you recommend?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
U-um, well, we grow all the fruits we<n>use in our
dishes, so I would suggest<n>our super-fruity cake!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
The toppings we use are freshly<n>picked each
morning from the garden<n>out back!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Lovely! I'll have one of those, then!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... This is delicious! The fruits<n>are all so juicy!
This cake must be<n>your best seller!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Well, some people do get hooked<n>after trying it
once, but I wouldn't go<n>so far as to say it's
particularly<n>popular among our guests.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... People are really missing out!<n>You should
try creating some buzz<n>around it by devising a fun
and flashy<n>way to serve it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
For example, you could let customers<n>harvest their
own fruits to decorate<n>their cakes!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You could call it the<n>"Pick-Your-Own-Fruit Cake"!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Wow... That's a great idea! That<n>would definitely
get people talking<n>about it! I'll try that out!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Pearl! You always<n>have such
unique ideas, and you're<n>always taking on
fascinating<n>challenges! I look up to you even<n>more
now!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, glad I could be of help. Youknow, I should be the one thankingyou for supporting me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several days later, Seeking the Pearl<n>receives
another fan letter from the<n>same cafe owner...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what fantastic news! It seems<n>the
Pick-Your-Own-Fruit Cake is a<n>huge hit!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I'm further exploring the potential of<n>homegrown
fruits by developing an<n>original beauty lotion." Haha,
sounds<n>like a great challenge to embark on!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But I can't let myself be beat! I'll<n>achieve even
more fabulous results<n>so I can help encourage
everyone<n>around the world!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From that day on, Seeking the Pearl<n>becomes even
more devoted to her<n>training.
